verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Justworks runs payroll and collects employees' filing status and withholding details. Nothing in the pack covers multi-state payroll, state tax registrations, or per-state withholding. Office-level overrides apply only to the Xero accounting mapping, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state
